description: A small black USB hub with several ports sits on the green bedspread in front of a blue pillow, with a black cable trailing behind it. The left hand reaches in from the left and moves toward the hub’s right-side cable connection, pinching and nudging the USB plug as if inserting or reseating it, while the right hand comes in from the right to steady the hub as a two-hand object; then both hands ease off and release it.
